message.value:
@concat(
    'Invalid Azure SQL FULL copy options: partition_option=',
    pipeline().parameters.p_copy_partition_option,
    ', partition_column=',
    pipeline().parameters.p_copy_partition_column,
    ', parallel_copies=',
    string(pipeline().parameters.p_copy_parallel_copies),
    '. Supported partition options are NONE, DYNAMIC_RANGE, and PHYSICAL_PARTITIONS; ',
    'DYNAMIC_RANGE requires partition_column; parallel_copies must be >= 0 ',
    '(0 means service-managed AUTO).'
)

sqlReaderQuery.value:
@concat(
    'SELECT *, ',
    'CAST(''',
    pipeline().parameters.p_batch_id,
    ''' AS VARCHAR(36)) AS [_batch_id], ',
    'CAST(''',
    pipeline().parameters.p_audit_pipeline_run_id,
    ''' AS VARCHAR(100)) AS [_pipeline_run_id], ',
    'CAST(''',
    variables('v_ingestion_timestamp'),
    ''' AS DATETIME2(3)) AS [_ingestion_timestamp] ',
    'FROM [',
    pipeline().parameters.p_source_schema,
    '].[',
    pipeline().parameters.p_source_object,
    ']',
    if(
        equals(
            toUpper(pipeline().parameters.p_copy_partition_option),
            'DYNAMIC_RANGE'
        ),
        ' WHERE ?DfDynamicRangePartitionCondition',
        ''
    ),
    ';'
)
